d:
After mercifully laying a slime girl to rest, Mia becomes one with her in body and souls.
With unfamiliar powers and a voice in her mind, she must decide: return to normal… or embrace the adventure of it.

A whole new world opens up around her with the help of her new body.
Corrupted slimes await salvation… and each encounter draws her deeper into sensations she doesn’t fully understand yet.

Of course, carrying such a burden doesn't mean she can't enjoy it along the way no?
